batch.topic: A walker is told to follow a painted marker after passing a water fountain; the fountain is a landmark, not the destination.
A ferry passenger can carry a folding bicycle if it remains folded; a full-size bicycle follows a different reservation rule.
A visitor’s booking lists a meeting point outside a station, while the activity begins in a courtyard reached together with the guide.
A guest receives a breakfast voucher valid for either morning of a two-night stay; using it once does not include both mornings.
